items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I happened to see Buck or something and Buck and I went on............

ctx.x: And he had a pad and a pencil looked like he was going to write something, but he never did get a chance to write it. And Mezz called, called me up and told me about it and I happened to see Buck or something and Buck and I went on............
Well Buck was, well we were living in the same building, you know?
